annotations.title: Add or remove VAT from a price

description: Calculate net, VAT amount and gross for a price in one country, applying its standard or reduced rate. Use it for European quotes and invoices; Latin American codes also work. Use vat_rates when you only need the rate. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: POST /vat/price via x402.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. DE, FR, CL.

direction.description: net-to-gross (default) adds VAT; gross-to-net removes it.

name: vat_price
